# validate/decode_empty_chain — an empty decode chain is rejected; decode is
# required.

! exec skopos validate -i spec.yml
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_stdout.txt

-- spec.yml --
ir_version: "1"

state:
  url:
    type: url
    default: "http://localhost:9999"

auth:
  none: {}

requests:
  - method: GET
    url: {ref: state.url}

response:
  decode: []
  events_at: response.body.events

pagination:
  none: {}

error:
  mode: standard
-- want_stdout.txt --
response.decode: error: decode is required (json|ndjson, or a list of stages ending in csv|json|ndjson)
